main.description: Serve the group's website at the domain of its handle, once the group has a handle on a domain of its own and that domain reaches this host: the domain serves the site, www. under it and the group's address redirect to it. Until the handle changes or deleteSiteDomain. Requires group.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

errors.name: NoOwnDomain
errors.description: The group's handle is its address here: it has no domain of its own to serve its site at.

errors.name: NotReaching
errors.description: The domain does not reach this host yet: asked, it did not answer as this host. Its A and AAAA records should name this host's addresses.

domain.description: The domain the site is served at: the group's handle, a domain of its own.
